rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the third round

categories.label: Score tokens won per round
categories.hint: Round score from your 5 trait cards: Anger 6, Benevolence 4, Lust 3, Greed 2 each; Courage and Hope scale by count (see notes). Take scoring tokens each round.

tiebreakers.description: The player who never held the Leader card wins

notes: family: rounds. Each round: deal 6 trait cards, draft down to 5, vote on highest scorer, showdown, greed steal, then scoring. Per-card values from the rulebook text: Anger 6, Benevolence 4, Lust 3, Greed 2; Courage 2/10/18 and Hope 0/6/21 depend on number held (exact thresholds unverified). Character abilities modify scores (e.g. +3, -1 per card). Lowest scorer of a round becomes Leader next round. Official rulebook (BGG file 'English Overseers Rulebook') could not be downloaded without a BGG login; BGG id 176803 is listed as 'Overseers'.
